period_boundary: 2025 H1 remains a binding gate and is not used to choose mechanisms, features, thresholds or weights.

family_I.threshold_20: improved every period but left 2023 at -1,487 JPY and PF 0.991953
family_I.threshold_40: made 2023 +731 JPY but harmed 2024 H2 by -1,196 JPY

reliable_development_facts.F05_exit_repair: closed because the only all-period-positive trajectory subset improved 2023 by only 1,077 JPY and could not close the 9,279 JPY portfolio deficit

family_J_wip_disposition.reason: The reversal payoff is algebraically derivable from Family I outcomes, so the WIP cannot claim blind preregistration. The current frozen monthly breadth gate is also already falsified by the implied development effects.

J_M4LE20.current_prereg_failure: 2024 H2 requires at least 4 positive and at most 2 negative effect months

family_J_wip_disposition.decision: Do not merge or evaluate the current WIP. Any future reversal family must be explicitly labeled development-outcome-derived and must have prospectively frozen 2025 gates without relaxing failed development breadth.

2023_blocker.interpretation: The accepted builder source was not committed. No 2023 portability metric may become binding until the exact 1,543-shift reconciliation is reproduced.

provisional_complete_strategy_portabilit.orientation_only_severe_cost_finding: All five strategies were negative under severe cost in the provisional 2023 reconstruction.
provisional_complete_strategy_portabilit.allowed_use: Prioritize exact transformer materialization and test whether the 2024 strategy universe truly transports to 2023; do not select a strategy from these provisional numbers.

hypothesis_priority.name: Exact complete-strategy portability
hypothesis_priority.claim: At least one already frozen 2024 complete strategy or fixed equal-weight leave-one-out portfolio retains positive full-year 2023 performance after exact legacy-2024 timestamp reconciliation and cost stress.
hypothesis_priority.why: An independent edge can add return without repeatedly trimming B02/F05 winners.
hypothesis_priority.next_test: Commit the exact transformer/evaluator, reproduce 1,543 shifted bars and exact 2024 H1/H2 regressions, then evaluate the fixed five-strategy cohort with no parameter changes.
hypothesis_priority.stop: No strategy or predeclared portfolio is positive in 2023 under default and severe cost.

hypothesis_priority.name: Long-horizon directional regime state
hypothesis_priority.claim: Cross-period sign reversals are explained by a pre-entry multi-day directional persistence state rather than recent strategy P/L or a fixed trade direction.
hypothesis_priority.why: 2024 strategy side contributions change sharply by half-year, while shadow strategy-health filters already changed sign and were rejected.
hypothesis_priority.next_test: After exact portability data exist, descriptively partition all fixed signals by predeclared 5-day and 20-day direction, path efficiency, volatility ratio and range position before any router family is proposed.
hypothesis_priority.stop: No fixed state has consistent directional effect across the four half-year development folds.

hypothesis_priority.name: Regime router between continuation and false-break actions
hypothesis_priority.claim: A fixed no-lookahead state can route a session breakout to continuation or mean reversion more robustly than static blocking.
hypothesis_priority.why: Weak B02 shorts lose across full development periods, but the 20-to-40-pip band reverses sign and cannot be separated by the tested local features.
hypothesis_priority.next_test: Only after RQ-020B identifies a stable state; no standalone Family J activation.
hypothesis_priority.stop: Routing requires outcome-derived thresholds, fails a half-year fold, or repeats Family I/J algebraic selection.

hypothesis_priority.name: Static multi-edge portfolio
hypothesis_priority.claim: A predeclared equal-weight portfolio of distinct fixed strategies can reduce regime dependence without dynamic optimization.
hypothesis_priority.why: Portfolio diversification is structurally different from local exit/filter repair.
hypothesis_priority.next_test: Evaluate equal-weight five and leave-one-strategy-out portfolios only after exact 2023 reconstruction.
hypothesis_priority.stop: Every predeclared portfolio remains negative in 2023 or fails severe-cost and leave-block-out robustness.

deprioritized_or_prohibited: additional Family I thresholds or 20-to-40-pip conditions
naive trailing strategy-PF or shadow-health switching
event/shock filters that repeat Families A/F
feature or threshold selection from 2025 H1
candidate interpretation from the provisional 1,428-shift 2023 reconstruction
